records.title: Speeding up Policy Simulation in Supply Chain RL
records.reason: The method speeds policy simulation in supply-chain RL; it does not address LLM generation or serving.

records.title: SWattention: designing fast and memory-efficient attention for a new Sunway Supercomputer
records.reason: SWattention is exact tiled attention specialized for Sunway SW26010. It reports 2.0x FP32/2.5x mixed-precision attention speedups and up to 1.26x GPT end-to-end training speedup; evaluation is training-focused/hardware-specific, without LLM serving inference.

records.title: Aurelia: CXL Fabric with Tentacle
records.reason: ACM primary abstract describes a CXL memory-fabric system but supplies no LLM serving workload or inference memory/latency result. Full text was not retrievable, leaving relevance unresolved.

records.title: Uniform Discrete Diffusion with Metric Path for Video Generation
records.reason: Uniform discrete diffusion for video generation is a video diffusion method, outside LLM inference.

records.title: Convolutional Neural Network Acceleration Techniques Based on FPGA Platforms: Principles, Methods, and Challenges
records.reason: This survey covers CNN acceleration on FPGA; its model family and serving target are vision CNNs, not LLMs.
